Yoga, as a spiritual discipline, is centered around achieving inner peace, harmony, and joy. The name Yokesh, derived from the Sanskrit word for joy, serves as a constant reminder of the ultimate goal of yoga practice – experiencing deep inner happiness and fulfillment. Additionally, in Hindu mythology, Yogeshwar or Lord Yoga, represents the supreme yogic power and is regarded as the embodiment of pure consciousness and compassion. Thus, the name Yokesh carries deep spiritual resonance and serves as an inspiration for those on the spiritual path to cultivate joy, peace, and self-realization in their lives.
